items.content_html: Server-Sent Events (SSE) is a lightweight, one-way push technology for streaming text updates from server to client over a long-lived HTTP connection. Unlike WebSockets, SSE is unidirectional (server→client), simpler to implement, and ideal for real-time push, logs, progress updates, or streaming data when the client only needs to receive events.
